newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-FERREIRA PUTS SOUTH AFRICA LEVEL IN DAVIS CUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FERREIRA PUTS SOUTH AFRICA LEVEL IN DAVIS CUP.

text.p: South African number one Wayne Ferreira beat Sweden's top player Thomas Enqvist to level the score at 2-2 in their Davis Cup quarter-final on Sunday.

Ferreira, nicknamed the Swede killer by local media, beat Enqvist 6-4 6-4 6-4 in the first of the tie's reverse singles, the third time in three years the South African, ranked 10th in the world, has beaten the seventh ranked Swede.
"I played too well for him," Ferreira said after the one hour 54-minute match.
"I hussled a lot and made a lot of returns and once I made the return and got into the point it was a great weapon."
Enqvist said everything had gone wrong with his game.
"I did not come up to my level of play and he was just too good," Enqvist said. "I have to play my best tennis to have a chance against him."
The decisive, final singles match for the right to meet Italy in the semifinal is between Sweden's Jonas Bjorkman and South African Grant Stafford.
